collected_observations_log.notes: First real-data pass under Task 5. One high-confidence first-party Platts index point (Hampton Roads-Paradip, 2014-06-05) plus three medium-confidence public market-report points (Hellenic Shipping News republishing Platts, South Kalimantan-Paradip, 2022-02-09; BigMint, Richards Bay-Paradip, 2026-01-22). All four routes remain far below the 24-observations-per-route minimum required by route_freight_model.py to train a route-specific model, so train_route_freight.py correctly reports status=inactive and every route as skipped rather than fitting a model on 1 point. No fabricated or interpolated rows were added; uncovered lanes (Gladstone-Dhamra, Taman-Paradip, Vostochny-Paradip, Richards Bay-Krishnapatnam, South Kalimantan-Krishnapatnam) still have zero observations and fall through to the existing market-proxy fallback as intended.

collection_rules: Never infer a route freight rate from BDI/BDRY/BCI or AIS alone and write it as observed freight_usd_per_t.
Do not convert TCE ($/day) into $/t without an explicit, documented voyage model and label it derived rather than observed.
Every non-empty freight value must have a source_url, source_reference, observation_type and verification_status.
Use verification_status=verified only after human review against the original public source.

Use confidence=high for official route/index observations directly visible in a first-party or publisher-controlled source; medium for independently published public report observations; low for ambiguous OCR/table reconstruction.
Fixtures and assessments must not be silently merged; keep observation_type explicit.
Keep source provenance and retrieval dates for every row.
